tolerance_over.note: Approve if over by <= min(approve_pct, approve_abs_inr); human review up to review_max_pct; above that send back (high reading confidence) or human (low).

tolerance_under.note: Approve with note if under by <= min(approve_pct, approve_abs_inr); beyond that human review unless a stated discount explains it.

vendor_match.note: rapidfuzz score: >= fuzzy_pass passes, between review and pass goes to human (H6), below review is a clear mismatch (S7).

date_sanity.note: Invoice date must fall between the PO date and PO date + max_months_after_po. Outside the window: human review (H10).

tax.note: Verify the current GST rate list before production use.

llm.note: Haiku 4.5 reads text PDFs (every key field is then verified against the PDF text); Sonnet 5.5 reads image-only PDFs, where nothing can be verified and Haiku misread a GSTIN in testing. Temperature 0 is sent to Haiku only: Sonnet 5.5 rejects non-default sampling settings.

document_types.note: The AI classifies every document. Anything else (quotation, proforma, credit note, ...) is read in full and passed to a human (H14), never sent back.
